title: Test 15 — Signal to noise ratio
agent_prompt: Change the exposure duration so the signal to noise ration of cell-background is 4:1. Acquire an image an show it in the napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: SNR measured before and after exposure adjustment
Image acquired at the adjusted exposure achieving 4:1 SNR
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
